description: This Java source file defines the class 'GenericHelperDAO', which implements data access operations for generic entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and querying entities, as well as checking the data source consistency.

classes.name: GenericHelperDAO
classes.description: A data access object class providing CRUD and query operations for generic entities in OFBiz.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database from a GenericValue.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a partial GenericValue by primary key, selecting only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple GenericValues by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Deletes an entity identified by its primary key.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching a condition, returning an iterator.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds related entities through multiple relations.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Updates an entity in the database.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Updates entities matching a condition with specified fields.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Verifies and optionally updates the data source to match entity definitions.
